label: sentinel-index
ok: {sentinel-index-unguarded} unguarded reads, {sentinel-index-strict-untested} untested strict reads (baseline or below)
remedy:
A table read whose index came from a reader that can answer in band must
be bound-tested — `if i < 0 || i >= tbl.length { … }` — or must take a
reader whose miss cannot be a real row. `vl check` returns 0 either way;
the difference is whether the COMPILER traps (D1440, D1462, D1500, #2498).
